ratchet_note: Phase 1 raises lines_min_pct to 100 for detent-core and modules; see PLAN §6.2. Phase 2 adds detent-platform at 97 (measured 97.02%, 4005/4128 lines, macOS unprivileged `cargo llvm-cov -p detent-platform --all-features`), after cutting privsep's `unreachable!` count from 96 to 2 by converting test bodies to the detent-core house style (`fn test() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>>` + `?`) and restructuring 5 flagged production-code sites (monitor.rs restore()/collect_backups() now carry the target path with each backup row instead of re-resolving it by id, so the id can't fail to resolve; enforce_deadline() uses Option::take_if to fold the expiry check and the take into one atomic operation; atomic_to_proto's RelativePath/BadDigest/Clock arms and worker.rs's variant_name Error arm are unreachable from their real call sites and are now covered by direct unit tests of those pure functions instead; transport.rs's read_exact_or_idle indexes buf[filled..] directly, since the loop invariant plus read(2)'s never-more-than-requested contract make the prior bounds-check's None arm provably unreachable). The floor is not 100 because of three honest gaps, none of them papered over: (1) privsep/spawn.rs's `sys::drop_to`, `resolve_worker_account`'s root branch, and `become_worker`'s `Some(credentials)` branch only run when euid==0; they are exercised by the new `spawn_pair_drops_to_the_worker_account_when_root` test (skips cleanly when not root) and pass under `docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/src" -w /src rust:1-bookworm bash -c "useradd -r detent && cargo test -p detent-platform --all-features"`, but this baseline is measured on an unprivileged run so those lines show uncovered here; (2) every forked child path (`sys::fork_process`'s `Side::Child` arm, `sys::exit_immediately`, and the worker-side branches of `spawn_pair_forks_a_working_pair`/`spawn_pair_drops_to_the_worker_account_when_root`) really does execute in the child process, but the child always terminates via `_exit(2)` (`sys::exit_immediately`), which is intentionally async-signal-safe and skips libc's `atexit` handlers — including the one `cargo-llvm-cov`'s instrumentation installs to flush the child's coverage profile to disk, so that execution is real but permanently unrecorded; this is a known llvm-cov/fork limitation, not a missing test; (3) host/mod.rs's `Os::Linux` dispatch arm and host/prober.rs's `/bin/false` path are Linux-only (`cfg!(target_os = ...)` branches that compile on every OS but only execute on Linux; they are expected to read as covered on the Linux CI slice), and the `Os::Other` arms in host/mod.rs (`compile_time_os` and `detect`) are provably unreachable on any concrete build since PLAN §1.6 scopes supported hosts to Linux and macOS only, so no test on any real target can ever take them. fs/atomic.rs (98.00%) and privsep/proto.rs (97.89%) were outside this task's assigned scope and are unchanged.
